about: Regular Mobic supplies for knee osteoarthritis span more than 90 days, and the patient reports no earlier trial of paracetamol alone for this pain.

Possible finding: the Celebrex supply dates span more than 90 days, but the as-needed directions leave actual use unclear and the record gives no osteoarthritis diagnosis, indication or prior paracetamol trial history.
Osteoarthritis is recorded and Mobic is supplied for about five months, but Panadol Osteo (paracetamol) was supplied three times earlier, so paracetamol has been tried.
